scenario: a turn driven past its watchdog with work still in flight
how: watchdogMs 6000, sent a turn that shells out to `sleep 40`

provenance.detail: completion is uncertain; this is not evidence of cancellation

note: The screen tail distinguishes the two things a timeout can mean. Here the terminal was still animating a thinking indicator, so the turn was alive and merely slow. A timeout on a dead session shows something else, which is the whole reason that caveat carries the screen.
